description: This file defines the 'SubjectCreated' event class used within a policy-based signaling framework in Eclipse Ditto. It models an event emitted after a Subject has been created, including serialization/deserialization from JSON, and provides accessors and builder methods for event properties.

classes.name: SubjectCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class representing the creation of a subject within a policy context, capable of JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of SubjectCreated with various parameter options, including deprecated ones.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SubjectCreated instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the policy entry.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the subject entity.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path to this event’s resource.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a copy of this event with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of this event with the specified Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Provides JSON building logic for serializing event data.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hashCode for proper object hashing.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides equals for object equality comparison.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event.
